# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 翟# (rise high) + 光 (light extending from a torch) → brilliant light radiating from a high place → *shine*; *radiance*; *brilliance*. Compare 燿.
A depiction of an aged person with a bent back (compare 久) → *old*; *elderly*.
考也。七十曰老。从人、毛、匕。言須髮變白也。凡老之屬皆从老。

A variant of 丂# as described in 号 (extend then bend) + 耂 an abbreviated form of 老 (aged) → elderly person with a bent back (compare 久). *Think* and *consider* are borrowed meanings, via 攷. Extended meanings include *idea*; *opinion*; *suggestion*; *intention*; *discretion*; *expectations*; *imagination*; *reflect on*; *prepare* (for); *intend to*; *expect* (that); *imagine* (that); and *contrive* (to). 考 also refers to one's deceased father; the character for one's deceased mother is 妣.
老也。从老省，丂聲。
毛# (fine strands of) hair + 老 (aged person) → the remaining strands of an elderly person's hair → *old person*; *grow senile*.

A depiction of brushwood/firewood piled on a stove. However, 者 was borrowed for use as a demonstrative pronoun, later evolving in meaning to the sense of "the one who does this" → *person*. The present form of 者 and certain derivative characters of 者 eliminate a diagonal stroke above 日, such as is retained for example in 堵, 屠 or 奢.
別事詞也。从𪞶纺聲。纺，古文旅字。

An abbreviated form of 老 (aged) + 旨# tasty → the delicious *taste* of cured/preserved food. This primary sense largely faded, with 耆 coming to refer to instead to human *aging* and/or senility. Compare 嗜, which was devised to replace 耆.
老也。从老省，旨聲。
As per 句# (bend) + 耂 an abbreviated form of 老 (aged person) → *aged person with a bent back* (compare 佝) → the *face of an elderly person* (especially, one marked by liver spots).
老人面凍黎若垢。从老省，句聲。
年八十曰耊。从老省，从至。
至# stopping point (of a life) + 老 (aged person) → *elderly person* (not far from death).
A depiction of a soft and droopy beard. Compare 冉. *Then*, *you*, *and*, *moreover*, and *but* are all borrowed meanings.
頰毛也。象毛之形。《周禮》曰：“作其鱗之而。”凡而之屬皆从而。
As per 而# (soft and droopy) + 大 stand outstretched → *soft* and droopy, human figure → *weak*.
稍前大也。从亣而聲。讀若畏偄。
罪不至髡也。从而从彡。
As per 而# (soft and droopy) + 寸 hand/action indicator → soften an object, improving its durability → *endure/bear*; *persist*; *withstand* → *be fitting*.
The relevant seal inscription form is 巾 cloth + an element# indicating a cylindrical bar → cloth hanging in neat alignment over both edges of a bar → *special* (← neat).
物初生之題也。上象生形，下象其根也。凡耑之屬皆从耑。
A depiction of a tri-pronged *plow*, an implement used to create long, rounded furrows.
手耕曲木也。从木推丯。古者垂作耒㭒以振民也。凡耒之屬皆从耒。
A variant form of 开# as described in 刑 (frame) + 耒 plow → *till* or *cultivate* with a frame-shaped plow.
犂也。从耒井聲。一曰古者井田。
Once written 秏, which is 禾 grain/rice + 毛# (fine objects) → fine particles of grain, decreased in size by polishing → *decrease*; *decline*; *wear down*. 禾 was later replaced by 耒 plow.
As per 云# (adhere) + 耒 plow → plow adhering to soil → *weed* (v.).
As per 巴# (spread) + 耒 plow → *harrow* (drawn by a beast of burden, that spreads over a field).
The right-hand element# is a variant of 已 (forked stick used as a plow). 耜 adds 耒 plow → a *plow*.
As per 助# (supplementary power) + 耒 plow → *plow*; *hoe* (n. and v.) (← implements that supplement human power). Compare 鋤.
商人七十而耡。耡，耤稅也。从耒助聲。《周禮》曰：“以興耡利萌。”
As per 昔# (pile) + 耒 plow → create piles of earth in *plowing*. Compare 鎡 and 鉏.
帝耤千畝也。古者使民如借，故謂之耤。从耒昔聲。
禺 here an abbreviated form# of 遇 (form a pair) + 耒 plow → *plow side by side* (aligned as a pair) → *team* (of two); *companion*; *line up*; *align*; *be in reciprocal relation*.
耒廣五寸爲伐，二伐爲耦。从耒禺聲。
As per 辱# (soften) + 耒 plow → use a *hoe* to soften earth in cultivating → *cultivate*.
As per 憂# (deliberate movement) + 耒 plow → using an *agricultural implement* similar to a plow, rake earth over planted seeds with a deliberate motion.
A depiction of a supple/soft *ear* clinging to the side of the head. Compare 乃.
主聽也。象形。凡耳之屬皆从耳。
A variant of 耼 (earlobe), replacing 冄 (variant of 冉) with 乚 a variant form of 乙 → *earlobe*.
An abbreviated form# of 邪 (crossroads settlement) + 耳 ear → cross-question → (grammatical) *interrogative* (← crossroads taken in a figurative sense). 耶 is also used for transliterations.
《國語》曰：“回禄信於耹遂。”闕。
冄 a variant form of 冉# (supple) + 耳 ear → supple *earlobe*.
耳曼也。从耳冉聲。
As per 冘# as described in 沈 (sink) + 耳 ear → drooping ears → *indulgence* (← droopiness) → *be absorbed in*. Compare 甚 and 淫.
耳大垂也。从耳冘聲。《詩》曰：“士之耽兮。”
火 fire + 耳 ear, with the meaning *bright*. 耳 is a replacement element, with the identity of the original element being uncertain.
耳箸頰也。从耳，烓省聲。杜林說：耿，光也。从光，聖省。凡字皆左形右聲。杜林非也。
軍法以矢貫耳也。从耳从矢。《司馬法》曰：“小罪聅，中罪刖，大罪剄。”
As per 令# (listen carefully) + 耳 ear → *listen carefully* → *hear*. Also, *wise*. 聆 was devised to replace 令 after 令 came to refer to orders themselves rather than their reception.
聽也。从耳令聲。
無知意也。从耳出聲。讀若孽。
As per 卯# (bend) + 耳 ear → figuratively bend/incline the ear in listening → *slightly*; *somewhat*; *a little* (← be able to hear only slightly).
耳鳴也。从耳卯聲。
安也。从二耳。
耳 ear + an abbreviated form# of 活 for the sound to simulate *clamor* → *noisy*.
驩語也。从耳𠯑聲。
As per 呈# (extend) + 耳 ear → figuratively extend the hear in listening attentively → *virtuous* (← superior practice) → *holy*. Compare 貞 and 聽.
通也。从耳呈聲。

As per 甹# as described in 娉 (pay a visit) + 耳 ear → pay a *visit* to learn of another person's intentions → *invite* → *employ* (← invite to take up a post). *Take a bride* is a borrowed meaning, via 娉.
訪也。从耳甹聲。
As per 取# (take hold of) + 乑 a variant of 從 (move/be in formation) → take hold of/*collect* an *assemblage* of people.
會也。从乑取聲。邑落云聚。
軍戰斷耳也。《春秋傳》曰：“以爲俘聝。”从耳或聲。
As per 門# (concealed) + 耳 ear → demand to *hear* concealed *information* → *ask*; *listen*; *rumor*; *reputation*.
知聞也。从耳門聲。
聰 is as per 悤# as described in 窓 (compression) + 耳 ear → *keen hearing* (← compressed concentration) → *sharp-witted*; *wise*. 聰 has been supplanted by the form 聡.
定 fix in place + 耳 ear → hear and settle for certain → *certainly*.
張耳有所聞也。从耳禹聲。
Abbreviated form# of 關 connect + 耳 ear → chain of linked ears, severed from the heads of enemy warriors (compare 馘) → *connect*; *join*; *align*.
連也。从耳，耳連於頰也；从絲，絲連不絕也。
察也。从耳怱聲。
As per 敖# (spread/roam without restraint) + 耳 ear → unfocused speech, hard for the listener to comprehend → *be difficult to make out*.
不聽也。从耳敖聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of 殸# combines a suspended piece of slate used as a percussion instrument with a hand holding a stick used to beat the slate and produce sound that carries over a great distance. A seal inscription form adds 耳 ear → (musical) *sound* that carries over a distance and enters the ear → *voice* → *rumor*; *reputation*.
音也。从耳殸聲。殸，籒文磬。
從 here an abbreviated form# of 縱 vertical + 耳 ear → prick up one's ears → *rise*; *tower* (over). *Strut* is a borrowed meaning.
As per 貴# (compress) + 耳 ear → *deaf* (← aural capacity reduced to nothing).
聾也。从耳貴聲。
An element# doubling 耳 ear (= ears) + another 耳 ear → ears figuratively pressed to a whispered voice (or, actually pressed to the lips of the whisperer) → *whisper*.
附耳私小語也。从三耳。
As per 戠# as described in 織 (marker) + 耳 ear → hear/take note of and mark down (as part of one's job) → *assignment*; *duties*; *employment*.
記微也。从耳戠聲。
垂耳也。从耳詹聲。南方聸耳之國。
As per 寧# (settle) + 耳 ear → *earwax* (that settles in the ear).

As per 𢛳# as described in 德 (one's true nature) + an element combining 耳 ear with the right-hand element of 廷 (extend straight) → pay heed to what is straight/true → *hear/listen* (compare 聖 and 貞) → *ask*.
聆也。从耳、㥁，壬聲。
As per 龍# (winding) + 耳 ear → elongated, deformed ear → *deafness*; *deaf person*.
無聞也。从耳龍聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form depicts an implement used to carve characters into wood, bamboo and so on. The character was later reinterpreted as indicating a *hand holding a writing brush*. *State* and *relate* are borrowed meanings.
所以書也。楚謂之聿，吳謂之不律，燕謂之弗。从𦘒一聲。凡聿之屬皆从聿。
始開也。从戶从聿。
An abbreviated form of 淵 (concentration) + an abbreviated form# of 晝 (demarcate in writing) → concentrate in writing → *quiet* (← quiet atmosphere promoting concentration); *solemn*.
持事振敬也。从𦘒在𣶒上，戰戰兢兢也。

Originally, 隶# seize + 镸/長 long → align objects that have been seized/obtained → *line up horizontally*; *shop/store*; *extend in length*. *Relax*, *do as one pleases*, *four* (used in documents as a precaution against forgery) and *therefore* are borrowed meanings. In the present form, 隶 is replaced by 聿.

Originally, a character that, like 畫, was composed of 晝 (demarcate in writing) + 聿 implement held upright to carve/draw characters → demarcate/mark off in writing. *Commence*, *begin*, *start* and *open* are borrowed meanings (compare 啓, the top element of which is the same as in 肇) → *originate*; *for the first time*.
擊也。从攴，肈省聲。
上諱。
A depiction of a slab of soft animal *meat* with the veins exposed → *flesh*.
胾肉。象形。凡肉之屬皆从肉。
胷骨也。从肉乙聲。
As per 力# (ripples) + 肉 flesh → rippling muscles of the *ribs*.
脅骨也。从肉力聲。
As per 几# (tall → tall and lean) + 肉 flesh → *skin* of a lean/starving person (compare 飢).
肉也。从肉几聲。
孰肉醬也。从肉九聲。讀若舊。
骨閒肉肎肎箸也。从肉，从冎省。一曰骨無肉也。
搔生創也。从肉丸聲。
As per 亡# (obscure) + 肉 flesh → obscure, *inaccessible region of the body (between the heart and the diaphragm*).
心上鬲下也。从肉亡聲。《春秋傳》曰：“病在肓之下。”
小# small + 肉 flesh → small offspring that *resemble* the parents in miniature. In derivative characters, 肖 often appears in the form seen for example in 悄, 逍 or 蛸.
骨肉相似也。从肉小聲。不似其先，故曰“不肖”也。
寸 here an abbreviated form# of 守 defend + 肉 flesh → defend oneself using a particular body part, the *elbow*.
臂節也。从肉从寸。寸，手寸口也。
小蟲也。从肉囗聲。一曰空也。
As per 土# (pile) + 肉 flesh → (full) *belly*, piled with food → (animal) *intestines*.
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 肉 flesh → the *anus* (lower end of the digestive tract).
干# thick bar + 肉 flesh → *liver* (← bar-shaped, vital organ) → *courage* (compare English "guts," as also in 腹 or 膽).
木藏也。从肉干聲。
As per 殳# (throw) + 肉 flesh → *thigh*; *crotch* (← throw one leg at a time over an object, such as in straddling it).
髀也。从肉殳聲。
支# branch + 肉 flesh → *the limbs*, likened to branches → *arms and legs*. Also, *branch element*.

The relevant seal inscription form is a variant of 卩 kneeling figure, here an abbreviated form# of 配 align + 肉 flesh → aligned layers of fat → (grow) *fat*; *gain weight* → *enrich*; *cultivate*; *fertilize*; *manure*; *night soil*. The contemporary form is 肉 + 巴.
多肉也。从肉从卪。
As per 不# (bulge) + 肉 flesh → *be pregnant*, the fetus creating a bulge → *embryo*.
婦孕一月也。从肉不聲。
A variant form of 肯 (originally, an arm hanging from a shoulder) → *shoulder*.
As per 方# (spread right and left, or in all directions) + 肉 flesh → spreading/protruding *flesh* → *fat*; *grease*.
𦘺也。从肉方聲。
As per 屯# (swollen) + 肉 flesh → swollen flesh → (dried) *bird gizzard*.
面頯也。从肉屯聲。
贅也。从肉尤聲。
朔而月見東方謂之縮肭。从月内聲。

A variant form of 肎 ( 冖 cover + 肉 flesh), indicating an arm hanging from a shoulder (compare 肩) and covering the side of the body. *Consent*, *agreement* and *permission* are borrowed meanings. In Old Chinese, neither 冖 nor 肉 conveys the pronunciation of this character, suggesting that a) one (or both) of the original components differed or b) one functioned as an abbreviated form of a now-obsolete character.
犬肉也。从犬、肉。讀若然。
厷# as described in 雄 (extend the arm) + 肉 flesh → *elbow* (← enabling extension of the arm). 肉 is for emphasis/clarification.

The relevant seal inscription form of the top element (now written 𠫓)# is 子 child upside down, indicating a fetus filling then passing through the birth canal → *breeding*. *Raise*, *upbringing* and *growth* are associated meanings, with *foster* (growth) by extension. The addition of 肉 flesh is for emphasis/clarification.
養子使作善也。从𠫓肉聲。《虞書》曰：“教育子。”
爻 cross/mix + 肉 flesh → meat crossing over or mixed upon a grill → (cooked) *meat/fish*; *side dish*.
啖也。从肉爻聲。
響，布也。从十从䏌。

The relevant seal inscription form of the right-hand element#, which in contemporary fonts can be identical in form with 市, combines 八 split right and left + a bud → buds split right and left. 肺 adds 肉 flesh → *lung* (← internal organ found on both sides of the chest).
金藏也。从肉巿聲。
夾𦟝肉也。从肉申聲。
The relevant seal inscription form is 肉 flesh + an obsolete element# combining 囗 circular enclosure and 米 rice → *stomach* containing meat/food.
穀府也。从肉；纻，象形。
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 肉 flesh → *descendant*; *lineage* (← physical manifestation of heritage running through generations). *Helmet* is a borrowed meaning, via 冑.
𦙍也。从肉由聲。
兜鍪也。从冃由聲。
骨差也。从肉失聲。讀與跌同。

As per 旦# (long and flat) + 肉 flesh → a long, flat piece of fat or grease → lip gloss (← lip gloss made from fat/grease). However, 胆 was adopted as a Shinjitai (new character form) to replace 膽, according to which 胆 bears the meanings *gallbladder*; *courage*; *pluck* and *nerve*.

As per 北# (back) + 肉 flesh (to emphasize the physical aspect) → one's curved *back* → *height*. Also, *contrariness*; *go back on* (one's word); *go against*; *disobey*; *go/turn away* and *avert* (← turn one's back on), as well as *carry on one's back*.
𦟝也。从肉北聲。
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 肉 flesh → *fetus* hanging heavily in the *womb* → *embryo*.
婦孕三月也。从肉台聲。
體四胑也。从肉只聲。
As per 半# (split) + 肉 flesh → *sliced meat from a sacrificial offering* → *wide-open*. *Fat* is a colloquial meaning unconnected to the etymology of this character.
半體肉也。一曰廣肉。从半从肉，半亦聲。
脣瘍也。从肉㐱聲。
牛百葉也。从肉，弦省聲。
As per 乍# (create a pile) + 肉 flesh → *offering of (piled) meat* → *happiness*; *blessings*; *bestow happiness*.
祭福肉也。从肉乍聲。
As per 甲# (press down upon) + 肉 flesh → *shoulder blade* (pressing down upon the muscles beneath).
犬膏臭也。从肉生聲。一曰不孰也。
As per 氐# (press) + 肉 flesh → *blister*, *callus* or *chap* caused by pressing on the skin.
腄也。从肉氐聲。
As per 包# (placenta) + 肉 flesh (for emphasis/clarification) → *placenta* → (object enveloped by a) *membrane*; *sac*.
兒生裹也。从肉从包。
A variant form of 胳 the *sides of the body*; *armpits*.
亦下也。从肉去聲。
古# hard; dried out + 肉 flesh → rough, dry beard covering the jowls → *barbarian* (← bearded foreigner) → *of foreign origin* (← barbarian foreigners). Compare 蕃.
牛𩔞垂也。从肉古聲。

The element in the middle combines 幺 slender thread + 肉 flesh → *posterity* (physical and figurative thread of lineage). 胤 adds 儿 person for emphasis/clarification → *lineage*; *descendant* → *inherit*.
子孫相承續也。从肉；从八，象其長也；从幺，象重累也。
As per 疋# (point in opposite directions) + 肉 flesh → group dismembering/separating a carcass (compare 解) → *assist*; *mutual*; *(all) together*. Also, *low-ranking official*.
蟹醢也。从肉疋聲。
As per 夸# (U-shaped crotch) + 肉 flesh → *crotch*. Compare 姱.
股也。从肉夸聲。
As per 光# (extend) + 肉 flesh → *bladder* (← expanding internal organ; compare 膀).
足大指毛也。从肉亥聲。
各# each + 肉 flesh → each *side of the body* → the *sides of the body*; *armpit(s)*. Compare 胠, 脇 and 亦.
亦下也。从肉各聲。
As per 同# (run through) + 肉 flesh → *trunk*; *torso* (that runs through the body between head and legs).
鳥胃也。从肉至聲。一曰胵，五藏緫名也。
As per 匈# (cavity of the breast) + 肉 flesh (for emphasis/clarification) → *breast*; *chest*; *thorax* → (one's) *mind*.
爛也。从肉而聲。
脛耑也。从肉行聲。
A depiction of a bear, a supple and powerful creature → *ability*; *skill*; *able* (← power/ability to accomplish something ← powerful) → *endure* (← power/ability to hold out) → *Noh* (← skill).
熊屬。足似鹿。从肉㠯聲。能獸堅中，故稱賢能；而彊壯，稱能傑也。凡能之屬皆从能。
大臠也。从肉𢦔聲。
